描述_EN: the leapfrog learning system is a interactive educational device, which is similar to a talking book. it teaches reading, vocabulary, science and even foreign languages. it was hugely successful on release and the british association of toy retailers awarded it preschool toy of the year in 2001.
描述_ZN: Leapfrog学习系统是一种互动教育设备，类似于一本会说话的书。 它教授阅读、词汇、科学甚至是外语。 它在发布时获得了巨大的成功，英国玩具零售商协会在2001年授予它年度学前玩具。
